snippet.title: Hoomanz! | Official Trailer | Coming Soon
snippet.description:
Scare away all the invading Hoomanz! 

⁉️ What is Hoomanz!?
You play as Shoo - the mythical guardian of Planet Erf with a not-so-mythical dislike of hugs. Shoo flips between forms depending on the light, scaring off pesky Hoomanz in a cozy, light-hearted stealth adventure. No combat, just cleverness, silliness, and family-friendly fun. 

🌟 Play Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156450/Hoomanz/

📅 Coming soon to Switch, Xbox, and Mac.

👉 Find out more on: www.hoomanz.game

🫂 Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hNx27YCKUD
